pr_title: Add `--generate-notes` flag to `gh release create` command.
pr_body:
Fixes #4466 

# TODO

- [x] We should not offer both Automatically generate the release notes and Write using commit log as template. These options are too similar (they both use git log to generate release notes) and we should prefer to use the new API and retire the old approach.
- [x] We should allow the editor phase for when you choose Automatically generate the release notes so you can review the release notes before posting. This API endpoint can be used for fetching generated release notes before a release is actually created.
- [x] If the API isn't available (e.g. in a GitHub Enterprise version), generating release notes should fall back to the current implementation of using the git commit log locally.
- [x] The non-interactive flag --generate-notes allows you to skip the editor phase. This would have the same behavior that you currently implemented, except that we propose that the flag name is shorter than --generate-release-notes.

issue_context.title: Support `generate_release_notes` flag on `gh release create`
issue_context.body:
### Describe the feature or problem you’d like to solve

- GitHub releases [automatically generated release notes](https://docs.github.com/ja/repositories/releasing-projects-on-github/automatically-generated-release-notes) feature for public beta.
- I want to support the flat on `gh release create` .

### Proposed solution

- Add `--generate-release-notes` to set parameter `generate_release_notes` for REST API.

### Additional context

- https://docs.github.com/en/rest/reference/repos#create-a-release
comments:
Would it be possible to add an optional parameter to specify the release to calculate the release note from?

Concrete case:
I have a repository with a repository scheme that doesn't follow the classic `vX.Y.Z` schema but a date-based schema: `rYYYYMM-XXXX`.

When using the feature in the UI, the latest `vX.Y.Z` release is used to calculate the release notes.

```
**Full Changelog**: .../compare/v0.6.0-preview0005...r202110-0004
```
@Kralizek I think we probably can support that but I would like to get just the basic functionality in first and then add support for that feature afterwards to keep the size of the changes small.
On a second thought, I think the behavior I explained earlier is actually a bug: generating release notes should always use the previous release as starting point by default.
How about a new subcommand to create release notes?

review_comments:
With this, we now offer two very similar options to the user:
```
? Release notes  [Use arrows to move, type to filter]
> Write my own
  Write using generated notes as template
  Write using git tag message as template
  Leave blank
```
Both "generated notes" and "git tag message" are generated using git history; the difference is that one is generated on the platform, while the other one is generated locally. Since the platform implementation is more advanced and configurable, I would only offer that one and not the "git tag message" option.
If we use blank string, conflict with automatically generated name and body.

Thanks for adding tests, there is one more case that I would like to see covered, and that is the interactive case where we actually make the network call to the generate release notes endpoint. There are no interactive tests for this command yet so that is already a bit suspect, and adding one is not trivial. If you feel like you are up to the challenge it would be greatly appreciated else I will add one once  we get the rest of the implementation details finalized.
I will try to add the interactive test on Saturday JST 💪
Can the `showable` interface now be eliminated too?
Looks like it is still used below in the `edit` function which is used in `GhEditor.prompt`.

If a body and title are provided and this parameter is set, what will take precedence when the release is actually created on GH? Additionally, what if only one of title/body is provided will the `generate_release_notes` parameter fill in the one that is blank?

> Whether to automatically generate the name and body for this release. If name is specified, the specified name will be used; otherwise, a name will be automatically generated. If body is specified, the body will be pre-pended to the automatically generated notes.
https://docs.github.com/en/rest/reference/repos#create-a-release

The `name` is used when specified and the `body` is prepended to the generated notes.

Thanks for the link, I probably should have read the API a little more closely before commenting. I think we should document this behavior in either the `long` or `examples` section of the command so that users with my same question will be able to find the answer using `gh release create --help` instead of having to search through the API documentation.

~~Also due to this behavior I think we need to set this parameter to false when the user is in interactive mode and selects to "Write using generated notes as template", else we will end up with duplicate bodies, one from what the user supplied and one from what is generated by the server.~~ 

Edit: Never mind that will already be the case. Ignore this comment.
